guards: checkpoint requires paused state; terminal evidence requires completed state
checkpoint rejects pending or uncertain action
checkpoint requires exact confirmed direct draft actions with claimed and dispatched provenance
checkpoint rejects unresolved_actions, unresolved_queue_mutations, queue actions, cross-room state, and stale status receipts
resume requires fresh explicitly running coordinator status after Resume
checkpoint count cannot exceed authoritative history
resumed observation cannot regress below durable history or revision
bounded batch retains last fresh observation and stop reason
interpretation: Accelerated multi-batch continuity evidence only. It does not establish 90 minutes of live browser wall-clock continuity or a canonical live browser run.
